_note: Planner output for the rl-runpod skill (2026-09-24). Merge 'hosts'/'runs'/'plan' into runs/campaign.json on the PC before launching; run ledger.py check first.

ann500_mappo_a.command: cd /workspace/sarsat/mapx_integration && MAPX_ROOT=/workspace/mapx VENV=/workspace/venv RUNS=/workspace/sarsat/runs XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_ALLOCATOR=bfc ./launch.sh mappo ann500_mappo_a sarsat-500sat-announced arch.num_envs=16 arch.num_eval_episodes=16
ann500_mappo_a.after: JAX_PLATFORMS=cuda python eval_checkpoint.py on the best checkpoint, seeds 1000-1015, after training exits; snapshot params + opt_states before teardown

plan.layout: one A40 48GB Secure ($0.49/hr; RTX A6000 $0.53 if no A40 stock), single slot, 16 envs, same recipe as ev500_mappo_a; nothing co-schedules (2x35 GB does not fit 48 GB)

checks.rule: user plateau rule (2026-09-23): after 20 evaluations, stop if max(last 10) <= best(earlier) + 0.005 and mean(last 10) <= mean(previous 10) + 0.003; snapshot the best checkpoint and run the paired-seed eval on the pod
no NaN/Inf in loss, value or return; no Traceback
not more than 0.05 below the run's best for 5 consecutive evaluations
> 0.50 by evaluation 10 (update 300); greedy_beam scores about 0.46 here
training env-steps/s within [220, 300] after the first evaluation

plan.keep_host: after the paired-seed eval and checkpoint pull: keep only if a follow-up run (seed 2, asymmetric critic, horizon 30) is queued to start within 30 min; otherwise tear down
plan.replan_when: plateau rule fires or run reaches 1500 updates; any escalate check; A40 and A6000 both unavailable at launch; host dies; user queues a follow-up
